decisions.reason: The source changes content-value and minimum-duration expectations but does not change permitted or required source material.
Requiring a full value or lesson does not alter the clean-editing, effects, or transition rules.
The source's 45-second approval threshold is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY event.
The source does not change caption color, font, effects, lettering, or position.
Delivering a complete value or lesson concerns standalone teaching completeness, not the separate standard for selecting strong source moments.
The source contains no audio or wind-noise instruction.
The next-batch clip standard does not change the Lead Clipper pathway, compensation, training, or responsibilities.
The source adds an approval criterion for individual clips but does not change the monthly quota, cadence, or rule that only approved clips count.
The source applies to the next production batch and does not change the completed qualification method, clip count, or success condition.
The source does not alter publishing destination, posting instructions, authorized clip count, or tracking requirements.
The source changes clip acceptance content and duration standards, not the submission channel, batch delivery method, or review-link workflow.
The generic approval gate remains unchanged; the specific 45-second criterion is already owned by the Clip Duration Requirement and the full-value criterion by the source Requirement.
